focus.command: cargo +1.94.1 test --offline --locked -p rodas5p-krylov --test n02_flexible_trigger_contracts --test n03_stage_interval_contracts --test n03_n02_guard_integration
focus.repair: Offer exact initial guess to original-residual/admissibility monitor with column 0, no operator basis construction. Output is committed only on monitor acceptance.
focus.N03_scope: Only given outward J and b enclosures, nonnegative shift and positive weighted inverse margin. Proof of physical membership and concurrency serialization supplied by caller.

stage_experiment.operator: W = I + theta (2I - S - S*) on periodic grid n=64; stationary right identity preconditioner. For semidiscrete diffusion theta=gamma*h*D/dx^2. One manufactured RHS per theta.
stage_experiment.measurement: Every actual product through accepted solve counted, including trigger residual checks; common post-hoc residual/error measurement excluded equally. Same unweighted relative residual threshold 1e-10, independent manufactured x*. Lower errors for baseline; not a matched-achieved-error comparison or full IVP speedup.

krylov_crate.note: Crate-wide invocation started before addition of shifted-diffusion test, which was run separately.
